selection: Repository native deterministic preflight, intelligence/tool quality, and six-case synthetic image corpus. No evaluated-model self grading.

image_corpus.media_hashes: Each media SHA-256 is retained in the referenced repository corpus.

quality.controls: Direct loopback, sequential requests, C1. Thinking-off and reasoning-low are separate candidate cells; incumbent off is a correctness control.

execution_order: managed vision reload and 12 image attempts
managed unload then incumbent preflight and repeated quality

measurement.warm_cold_state: Cold managed start followed by sequential mixed warm probes; no controlled performance series.
measurement.statistics: Pass counts only; incidental latency/throughput fields are not headline performance evidence.
